title: Alpha Flight #71 Marvel Comics 1989 Resurrection of the Sorcerer
descriptionText:
Alpha Flight #71 (June 1989, Marvel Comics) -- "The Resurrection of the Sorcerer." Cover price $1.50 US.

Condition: Very Good. I have multiple copies of this issue; condition may vary slightly between copies, but all are in a similar Very Good range -- please review all photos as they're of the actual copy you'll receive.
